description:
This talk is a tour through several different CPython security issues to illustrate the different forms security problems and their solutions can take in a modern programming language.

📌 Benjamin Peterson (https://twitter.com/gutworth) is a core developer of CPython and PyPy. He also wrote "six", a Python 2/3 compatibility library.

🚀 Partners:
On The Spot https://onthespotdev.com/ 
Orca Security https://orca.security/

title: Several CPython Security Issues
